selection_rule: First forty frozen rows from each of the five most recent owner packets

records.source_title: Raw byte capsules preserve binary payloads
records.source_acceptance: Hash raw bytes without decoding, stripping, or newline conversion.

records.source_title: Git blob capsules retain their declared domain
records.source_acceptance: Use immutable blob bytes and never substitute checkout bytes.

records.source_title: UTF-8 LF capsules normalize CRLF pairs only
records.source_acceptance: Convert CRLF pairs to LF while preserving lone CR, trailing spaces, and final-newline absence.

records.source_title: Invalid UTF-8 is refused in the text domain
records.source_acceptance: Strictly reject undecodable text while allowing the same bytes in the raw domain.

records.source_title: Byte domain names are mandatory and closed
records.source_acceptance: Reject missing or unknown domains instead of guessing text or binary.

records.source_title: Normalization is independent of chunk boundaries
records.source_acceptance: Carry a pending CR across chunks and yield the same digest for every tested partition.

records.source_title: Relative paths preserve Unicode spelling
records.source_acceptance: Accept NFC relative POSIX paths without rewriting the recorded spelling.

records.source_title: Parent and dot segments are refused
records.source_acceptance: Reject empty, dot, and parent segments before any filesystem access.

records.source_title: Absolute and drive-relative targets are refused
records.source_acceptance: Reject rooted paths, drive prefixes, network paths, and colon-bearing components.

records.source_title: Backslash ambiguity is refused
records.source_acceptance: Require slash separators and reject Windows path spellings in portable manifests.

records.source_title: Control characters are refused in paths
records.source_acceptance: Reject NUL, line breaks, tabs, and other control characters before Git batch requests.

records.source_title: Windows filename aliases are quarantined
records.source_acceptance: Reject reserved device names, trailing dots or spaces, and case-fold collisions.

records.source_title: Manifest output has deterministic ordering
records.source_acceptance: Sort entries by literal path and reject nondeterministic duplicate entries.

records.source_title: Manifest path sets match the explicit allowlist
records.source_acceptance: Require equality between expected files and manifest targets, including missing and extra paths.

records.source_title: Manifest entry digests use exact bytes
records.source_acceptance: Verify SHA-256 and byte counts against the declared domain for every target.

records.source_title: Manifest modes and object types are explicit
records.source_acceptance: Accept regular-file modes and refuse symlink or submodule materialization.

records.source_title: Manifest exclusions are separately accounted
records.source_acceptance: Require a named self-exclusion set disjoint from hashed targets.

records.source_title: Manifest limits reject oversized inventories
records.source_acceptance: Reject inventories above the declared file ceiling without expanding scope.

records.source_title: Receipt anchors require full commit identifiers
records.source_acceptance: Reject abbreviated, malformed, or missing immutable commit identifiers.

records.source_title: Lifecycle edges require direct single parents
records.source_acceptance: Check source to x1 to evidence to final as direct single-parent relationships.

records.source_title: X1 trees contain planning artifacts only
records.source_acceptance: Refuse x2 or final paths in the immutable planning commit delta.

records.source_title: X1 planning bytes remain unchanged in descendants
records.source_acceptance: Compare the planning file map at x1 with the evidence and final maps.

records.source_title: Owner scope cannot cross an adjacent prefix
records.source_acceptance: Use path components to prevent a similarly named sibling prefix from passing.

records.source_title: Canonical scope lists only introduced files
records.source_acceptance: Bind the exact source-to-final file allowlist without a history-wide inventory.

records.source_title: Core outcomes use the four accepted labels
records.source_acceptance: Reject outcome values outside completed, represented, open_gap, and exact_gate.

records.source_title: Inherited revalidation receives zero new credit
records.source_acceptance: Require inherited rows to retain zero novelty and zero current completion credit.

records.source_title: Failed aggregates cannot receive success credit
records.source_acceptance: Require aggregate-success credit to remain zero for invalid results.

records.source_title: Dependency recovery preserves the failed aggregate
records.source_acceptance: Link a passing recovery to its original failure without relabeling the aggregate.

records.source_title: Same-owner validation cannot become independent
records.source_acceptance: Reject independent-reproduction claims on owner-local receipt evidence.

records.source_title: Protected gates cannot be closed by software passes
records.source_acceptance: Keep empirical, authority, identity, production, and Stage 20 boundaries unresolved.

records.source_title: Failure identifiers remain unique
records.source_acceptance: Reject duplicate failure and witness identifiers.

records.source_title: Recovery witnesses name existing negatives
records.source_acceptance: Refuse orphan recovery links and absent predecessor failures.

records.source_title: Ledger extension retains every prior record
records.source_acceptance: Compare prior immutable records with the new extension and reject removals.

records.source_title: Ledger corrections append replacement evidence
records.source_acceptance: Require correction links while preserving original record content.

records.source_title: Method promotion requires a passing witness
records.source_acceptance: Refuse preferred methods whose named witnesses contain no pass.

records.source_title: Ledger totals are derived from retained rows
records.source_acceptance: Recompute new failure and recovery counts without importing inherited counts twice.

records.source_title: Canonical reservation is exclusive
records.source_acceptance: Use exclusive creation so a second attempt cannot overwrite a reserved receipt.

records.source_title: Canonical reservation binds the exact owner and head
records.source_acceptance: Record source, x1, evidence, final, and attributable owner before execution.

records.source_title: Incomplete canonical execution receives zero credit
records.source_acceptance: Retain a reserved or interrupted state until an attributable final result exists.

records.source_title: Canonical finalization cannot replace earlier evidence
records.source_acceptance: Write the completion result once while retaining the reservation and all failures.
